title: Hachis Parmentier
creator: bohemienwales
statusNote: The creator gives no amounts; all quantities are estimates. The steps were reconstructed from the voice-over and the video. The transcript's misheard words were read as beef, leek and Comté.
steps: Season the diced beef and brown it in batches in a hot casserole with the oil, then set it aside.
In the same pot, gently soften the diced leek, onion and carrot without colouring them.
Return the beef, pour in the veal stock and add the bay leaves.
Cover and braise over a low heat (or in a low oven) for about 3 hours, until the beef falls apart with a spoon.
Let the filling cool to room temperature, remove the bay leaves and spoon it into an ovenproof dish.
Boil the potatoes until tender, drain well and pass them through a ricer.
Season the potatoes, then beat in the butter and egg yolks until smooth.
Pipe the potato generously over the beef and cover with plenty of finely grated Comté.
Chill the dish until completely firm.
Bake in a hot oven (about 200 °C) until deeply golden and crisp, and the filling is piping hot.
notes: Chilling before baking helps the piped potato hold its shape and crisp up. Oven temperature is an estimate.
